overview: Thurlestone Hotel is a large coastal hotel in Thurlestone village on the South Devon coast, with most rooms looking out to sea. Alongside hotel rooms and family suites it has four apartments, indoor and outdoor pools, a spa, a restaurant and its own village pub. Bantham and Thurlestone's beaches lie close by along the coast.
surfTripFit: A comfortable base for families or mixed groups where not everyone surfs, with pools, spa and golf on site and Bantham nearby. It is a full-service hotel rather than a surfer-focused stay, with no board storage mentioned.
